{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored wool-blend suit jacket, structured single-breasted cut with notch lapels, charcoal gray #3E4A56, fine woven wool.
Slim-leg tapered trousers, straight fit through thigh tapering to ankle, charcoal gray #3E4A56, fine woven wool.
Silk-cotton blouse, relaxed collar with slight drape at neckline, soft ivory #FFFFF0, smooth poplin fabric.
Low block heel pumps, closed toe with almond shape, matte black #000000, polished leather.
Matte gold pendant necklace, delicate chain length resting at collarbone, 18k gold vermeil, solid metal.
Structured leather clutch, rectangular silhouette with top zip closure, deep espresso brown #3B2F2F, smooth calfskin leather.

This outfit works because the charcoal suit strikes the right balance between professional authority and approachability required for an analyst interview in a corporate bank setting. The silk-cotton blouse introduces a subtle softness that prevents the ensemble from feeling too rigid while maintaining a polished silhouette suitable for autumn morning daylight. Gold accessories add a touch of modern elegance without distracting from the core message of competence and attention to detail she aims to convey."}
